title: Shell Island Ferry

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Cruise to Shell Island and explore St. Andrew Bay aboard your own pontoon boat from Panama City Beach Boat Rentals, home of the famous Shell Island Pontoon Boats. Conveniently located at 5709 Lagoon Dr. Panama City Beach Fl 32408 right next to the east end of the Grand Lagoon Bridge. Recreational boating is one of the top things to do in Panama City Beach, and nothing can match a pontoon boat from Panama City Beach Boat Rentals when it comes to fun on the water with a family or other large group.
